S32.31.needs: a chat artifact (the app must have made one)
S32.31.note: The Code line's quoted locations (ArtifactPreview.tsx:745 and WebChatPage.tsx:5834) are gone; the real code is the handleDownload function at ArtifactPreview.tsx:1381 and the menu at ArtifactPreview.tsx:3494, which writes a preview document built by buildArtifactPreviewDocument; the offline check is not confirmed by the code.
steps: In a chat, ask for a single-page web design, for example "make a one-page landing page", and wait for the artifact card to appear.
Click the artifact card so the artifact opens in the artifacts panel.
Click the download icon in the artifact's top bar (tooltip "Download").
Click "Download as HTML" in the menu.
Open the saved .html file in a browser with no internet connection and check that the design shows on its own, matching the preview in the app.
S32.31.where: Chat > open an artifact from the chat (the artifact card opens the artifacts panel) > Download (download icon, tooltip "Download") > Download as HTML

steps: Make two or more artifacts in one chat, for example two designs or a design and a diagram.
Open the artifacts panel and click "Download all" (title "Download all artifacts as zip").
Wait for the toast "Artifact download ready" and open the downloaded zip to check that each artifact is inside as a file.
For an image artifact, click the download icon (tooltip "Download") to save the image file.
For a diagram, open the download icon menu and click "Download as SVG"; open the .svg file and compare with the preview.

S32.34.needs: a chat artifact with at least two versions
S32.34.note: Code confirmed: ArtifactPreview.tsx:994 and 3211, ArtifactChangesView.tsx:53 and 103, theme-contrast test at line 385 exist; "Show changes" is hidden for PDF, DOCX and image artifacts; the version history button's label is aria-only ("Show version history"), so the tester sees only the v-number.
steps: Ask the chat to change the same design once, so the artifact has two versions.
Open that artifact and click the "More" icon at the top right of its top bar, then click "Show changes".
Read the summary line (it starts "Since version") and the added and removed marks, and compare with Expected.
Click the version counter in the header (it shows v and two numbers, for example v1/2), then click "Restore" on the older version.
Click "Restore" in the dialog titled "Restore version N?" and check that the older content shows and a new latest version appears in the list.
S32.34.where: Artifacts panel > open an artifact with two or more versions > More (the "..." icon at the top right of the artifact) > Show changes; then the version counter in the artifact header > Restore
